test_evidence: Evidence Desk shared-core selftest and browser dogfood, 11 July 2026
purpose: Turn observed run facts into a compact receipt without merging execution and verification.
rules: An observation without a source remains visible and is marked unsourced.
Execution is never relabelled as verification.
Receipt generation is read-only; saving or exporting is a separate gated action.
boundaries: Does not inspect files by itself.
Does not apply patches or execute shell commands.
Does not authenticate a caller from a supplied display name.
